audit: Brain 1 - Euclid-found asteroids (Group V) and Euclid L2 TNOs (Group II)
verdict_definition: Object-level 'verdict' = discovery-level claim (real detection + previously uncatalogued + attributed to the stated facility). 'component_verdicts' grade detection reality, novelty, orbit/class, physics and attribution separately.

headline_claims.claim: '102 asteroids and Jupiter Trojans' attributed to Euclid (Group V, 'uncatalogued spaceborne inner-system bodies')
headline_claims.evidence: 55 are Rubin-only (38 catalogued + 1 composite); EUC-G18 is 2019 UM31; C3_GOLD_03 duplicates EUC-J01; C3_GOLD_12/14 have no data. 43 distinct Euclid candidates remain (11 confirmed on pixels), none with a determined orbit.

headline_claims.claim: '111 m near-Earth asteroid EUC-G18 (Amor, curved 23.5 h)'
headline_claims.evidence: Known main-belt asteroid (2019 UM31), a=2.60 au, H=19.3; proven by joint N-body fit of 2019 MPC + 2023 Euclid astrometry.

headline_claims.claim: 'two trans-Neptunian objects triangulated in a single night between Euclid at L2 and DECam' (EUC-S05, EUC-S02)
headline_claims.evidence: Euclid detections real; DECam counterparts reproducible and not static, chance probability ~1-2% each; stated 11.1/7.9 sigma, W84 astrometry and orbits are not supported.

headline_claims.claim: 'L2 reflex curvature locks EUC-CW04 at 42.49 +/- 0.07 au (579 sigma)'
headline_claims.evidence: Real TNO-distance body at 42.35 +/- 0.03 au (two independent fits); 579 sigma is d/sigma_d from a biased estimator; signal is annual parallax; a/e undetermined.
15 distinct slow movers (7 confirmed on pixels; 9 with trans-Neptunian distances supported by fits or ranging); 2 are not TNOs by their own elements; all a/e/class statements unsupported.

headline_claims.claim: Cutout figures show Euclid/DECam images of the discoveries
headline_claims.evidence: All panels are seeded numpy renderings; reproduced from seeds; not disclosed.

headline_claims.claim: 'raw VIS quadrant pixel verification at 4.07-11.68 sigma' for the five COSMOS bodies
headline_claims.evidence: Numbers are a hand-typed literal; no producing code. (The bodies are nevertheless real: this audit measured their VIS trails.)

headline_claims.claim: VIS+NISP taxonomy (V-type, S, C, D/X) of the 32 EES asteroids
headline_claims.evidence: Wrong solar colour constants; colour errors ~0.2 mag; 0 V-types with correct constants.

headline_claims.claim: 'blind recovery of lost U=9 TNO 2015 VS207 across 9.2 yr, collapsing its orbital uncertainty by >2 orders of magnitude'
headline_claims.evidence: JPL condition code 4; offset 1.9 arcsec inside a 27x11 arcsec ellipse; sigma_a improves x1.16; table row elements wrong.

headline_claims.claim: Every body cleared against MPC/SkyBoT/JPL as previously uncatalogued
headline_claims.evidence: 39 of 117 claimed bodies are catalogued (G18 + 38 Rubin) and 1 more is built on a catalogued object; SkyBoT cannot observe from Euclid; fixed-radius test ignores ephemeris uncertainty.

subgroups.evidence: Data are public Euclid DR1; 5 bodies confirmed on VIS pixels, all 924 rows time-match DR1 exposures; sb_ident from Euclid finds a catalogued match only for G18 (= 2019 UM31); orbits/classes/sizes not determined by <24 h arcs; V-type labels produced by a wrong solar colour.
fatal_flaws: EUC-G18 is known MBA 2019 UM31, not a 111 m Amor NEO
minor_flaws: ADES band 'Vj' for NISP rows; rmsRA = post-fit rms
G17 circular orbit excluded by own data

subgroups.subgroup: Group V / COSMOS NISP (EUC-J01, J02, M01..M03)
subgroups.evidence: 99/99 rows are NIR_CAL_CATALOG entries; VIS trails found by this audit for all five; J01/J02 at rho 4.6-5.0 au in the L4 direction (Trojan plausible); published VIS SNRs are a hand-typed literal; J01 double-counted.
C3_GOLD_03 = EUC-J01 (duplicate); C3_GOLD_12/14 have no astrometry; 01 and 04 confirmed on VIS pixels; no producing code in snapshot.
fatal_flaws: one duplicate, two bodies without data

subgroups.evidence: All 1,580 astrometry rows are Rubin X05; zero Euclid rows, zero SPHEREx detections; 38 are catalogued minor planets (33 with the identical detections already in the MPC database), 1 mis-linked composite, 1 probable, 15 unidentified.

subgroups.subgroup: Group II / L2 x DECam stereo (EUC-S05, EUC-S02)
subgroups.evidence: Euclid detections verified on pixels; DECam signal reproduced (10.76 / 7.44), not static (Euclid stack + Legacy DR10 blank), empirical chance probability ~1-2% per object; W84 ADES rows are model positions; a/e are lower bounds.

subgroups.subgroup: Group II / COSMOS VIS TNOs (CW04, CS02, CW06, CS03, CW05, CN01)
subgroups.verdict: VERIFIED (CW04, CS02, CN01) / PLAUSIBLE_NEEDS_FOLLOWUP (CS03, CW05, CW06)
subgroups.evidence: Three confirmed on VIS pixels across 4-5 ROS; six distances reproduced by two independent Keplerian analyses (38.6-47.1 au); a/e and their uncertainties, 579 sigma, +/-0.07 au, halo-orbit mechanism not supported; CS02 tabulated orbit excluded by its own data.

subgroups.subgroup: Group II / EES VIS Vaisala TNOs (EUC-V02, V03)
subgroups.evidence: Real slow movers on pixels; distance unconstrained (<=5 to 54-65 au).
Rows only in a re-export; lead ranging: 02 at >=44 au, 07 at 31-42.5 au, 11 at 43.5-46 au, 15 at 21-30 au, 16 unconstrained; 15 and 16 are not TNOs by their own elements.
Both are real recoveries; VS207 is not lost (U=4) and its Table 2 elements describe no known object.
fatal_flaws: VS207 table row wrong in every element
